work_item: P2 Core Domain Persistence: Evidence PostgreSQL implementation

c2_reuses_existing_postgresrepository_ba.evidence: Extends PostgresRepository from identity/implementation/repositories/base.repository.ts; inherits OCC, RLS, connection pooling

c3_follows_singleton_pattern.evidence: Matches work-postgres.repository.ts pattern: getEvidenceRepositoryPostgres() singleton factory function

c4_enforces_evidence_immutability.evidence: Overrides save()/remove() to throw errors; only saveEvidence() allowed (insert-only, matches migration 005 RLS policy)

c5_rls_context_handling_implemented.evidence: Calls setSessionContext()/clearSessionContext() in saveEvidence() to enforce tenant isolation before/after insert

c6_backward_compatibility_maintained.evidence: Conditionally uses PostgreSQL repository only if DATABASE_URL is present; falls back to EvidenceRegistryRepositoryFileSystem otherwise

c7_typescript_compiles.evidence: npx tsc --noEmit on evidence files returned no errors (only non-blocking tsconfig.json loaded warning)

c8_architecture_lock_enforced.evidence: git diff --stat enterprise/ governance/ returned empty output - NO modifications to frozen directories

c9_p2_core_domain_all_persisted.evidence: All four core domain elements now have PostgreSQL persistence: users (user.repository.ts), tenants (tenant.repository.ts), work (work-postgres.repository.ts), evidence (evidence-postgres.repository.ts)

c10_no_overbuilt_schema.evidence: Minimal implementation only, uses existing evidence table from migration 005; no new tables or enterprise schema additions
